correctness.rationale: Independently re-executed the exact certificate: cycle types are (4,2,2,1,1,1,1), (6,3,2,1), (6,4,2); t0*t1*tinf is identity under the stated left-to-right convention; the group acts transitively on 12 points; Riemann-Hurwitz deficits 5+8+9=22 give genus 0; parities (-1,+1,-1) consistent with S12. Sympy Schreier-Sims on the seed triple gives order 479001600, transitive and primitive, hence H=S12. By Riemann existence this is a complete proof of existence over C. Census aggregates reproduce (532032 raw rows, 831 classes, class-size distribution {192:1,384:275,768:555}, 488 transitive reps, group-order table match); seed maps to class 229. DRAFT honestly scopes to C and leaves moduli/descent open.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent-encoding, and dominance directions returned no prior record of this exact passport or triple. LMFDB Belyi database caps at degree 9 so cannot contain a degree-12 record. Full-text parameter searches of Sijsling (60pp survey), Pakovich (Hurwitz existence, 29pp), and Adrianov ((2,3)-trees, 6pp) find no matching partitions or triple. Existence is not mechanically implied: Riemann-Hurwitz is only necessary and Hurwitz obstructions exist in general, so the explicit transitive triple is a new witness at the record standard.

The affirmative answer (explicit transitive S12 triple, genus 0, census context of 831 classes with singleton pure-braid orbits and rational branch classes) is a rigorously established exact fact a future researcher could need, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained number. The incomplete surrounding program (no certified Q-model, moduli undetermined) is disclosed honestly and does not erase the self-contained headline existence result over C.
